description: List the outcomes linked directly under one outcome group (outcome_group_id), not its subgroups' outcomes. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Each link nests the outcome (full detail when outcome_style="full", abbreviated otherwise); use list_outcome_group_subgroups to descend into child groups first, or get_outcome for one outcome's full detail by outcome_id.

context_id.description: The Canvas account ID or course ID for the context.

outcome_style.description: Outcome detail level. Use "full" to include expanded outcome fields.

name: list_outcome_group_outcomes
title: List Outcome Group Outcomes
